text: Syed Osman Ali was a Pakistani civil servant who served as the Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan from 1975 to 1978. He studied economics and started his career in the Indian Civil Services in 1934. Between 1959 and 1966, he held the position of Federal Secretary in the Ministries of Industries, Commerce, and Economic Affairs. From 1968 to 1972, he served as the executive director of the World Bank in Washington. He also served as Pakistan's Ambassador to Belgium and Luxembourg from 1966 to 1968.
